BL-779 — A control pause freezes chase/rotation but the flow-watchdog alarm never says so — a paused swarm alarms '⚠️ WARN flow-stall … - rotate' and reads to a human as a starve
What it solves: Sibling of BL-651, not a duplicate: BL-651 decides WHO the resident should
be; this one is about telling the human why nobody is deciding at all.
Orthogonal file scopes — BL-651 touches `mono_router_lib.bb` /
`handoffd.bb` `role-mail-row`; this one touches `flow_watchdog_lib.bb`'s
alarm text plus w…
Approval context: Found by the specifier on 2026-08-01 while auditing the live evidence attached to BL-651's queue-jump: the "starve" the human queue-jumped for was a control pause the operator had set four minutes earlier. The fix proposed is observability only (say "paused until X" in the alarm and in the operator…
BL-779 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-779" (or "reject BL-779 <reason>") to act.
